note: Legal name 'Rossari Biotech Limited' confirmed from the company's own website (rossari.com), which describes it as 'one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers' with seven manufacturing facilities and 332,000+ MTPA capacity — hence role = manufacturer (self-declared on official site, not independently registry-verified). CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status and registered-office state could NOT be verified in this session: DuckDuckGo search returned connection errors (no results at all), zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and all attempted rossari.com investor-relations/annual-report/financial-information/contact URLs returned HTTP 404. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status and registered state are left null rather than guessed. Revenue FY25 and FY26 left null: no audited accounts or official filing could be retrieved (IR pages 404, aggregators blocked); no figures invented. Registry existence is not in doubt (listed company with active corporate website), so no rejection. HS codes declared (110813, 290711, 290949, 291219) do not match the actual product profile (surfactants, polymers, silicones, enzymes, textile/performance chemicals) — per project rules this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to its actual chemistry (e.g. 3402/3809/3507 surfactant-enzyme preparations). Verdict: accepted_hs_corrected, with the caveat that registry identifiers (CIN/PAN/GSTIN) and revenue remain unverified and must be re-checked against MCA/GST portals.
